name: AIS API: CVE intelligence + Agent Flight Recorder
description: AIS daily CVE prioritization — ranked by real exploitation (KEV + EPSS + KEV-recency), regenerated daily. https://aislabs.ai/api-docs No account needed: pay per call over x402 (HTTP 402, exact scheme, USDC on Base), or send a Gateway key (Authorization: Bearer ais_k_..., https://aislabs.ai/gateway/). Keys are scoped per building: CVE key $19 / 30 days, Flight Recorder key $19 / 30 days, campus pass $29 / 30 days or $149 / 12 months (every building). Paid once, nothing renews.
